quotes: The term “applicant” is used hereinafter for the individual whose citizenship and identity is being adjudicated, including for form DS-2060.
judgments.rationale: The source explicitly defines 'applicant' in the opening NOTE. The draft currently lacks any claim addressing unit U0000, so adding this definition fixes an omitted provision without altering terms or conditions.

quotes: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
judgments.rationale: Paragraph a directly defines 'material discrepancy'. In the draft audit, this definition was flagged as missing under unit U0002. Adding this definition claim restores omitted normative text faithfully.

Paragraph b establishes a mandatory requirement to document material discrepancies using one or more listed acceptable document categories, subject to the married names exception. Units U0004 through U0009 were unrepresented in the draft claims, making this complete addition fully supported and necessary.

quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:
judgments.rationale: The introductory sentence of paragraph d sets out the Department's authority under 22 CFR 51.23(c) where evidence of identity might be required. This corresponds to missing inventory unit U0012 and accurately mirrors the source language and modal force.

quotes: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
judgments.rationale: Paragraph d(2) explicitly includes the statement that applicants generally will need name change documentation to update the name on their ID. This addresses missing inventory unit U0015 and accurately preserves the source meaning.
